draft_reason: The organism has empirical multi-scale language scattered across foundation docs, but no machine-readable property projection map yet.
promotion_condition: each mapped property has explicit evidence sources, scale-specific projections, and a validity boundary; Planck-limit language is treated as a description limit, not a governance layer.
purpose: Map organism properties across scales empirically so governance, organs, cells, wrappers, and physical limits can be compared without collapsing into metaphor.

validity_rule.description: The same property nucleus may be projected at every scale, but the representation changes; below the physical-description limit, the map is descriptive only and must not be used as governance authority.

representation.identity: CYNIC as a sovereign bounded body
representation.boundary: repo, registry, kernel, fleet, agent surfaces
representation.energy: physical, network, compute, human attention, lifecycle pressure
representation.flux: observations, tasks, registry changes, deployment dispatch
representation.memory: kernel mempool, git history, durable source-of-truth files
representation.observation: cynic organism, cynic attention, health and audits
representation.invariant: policy decides the layer; kernel does not own external truth
representation.failure_mode: fragmentation, stale projections, hidden wrappers, local build drift

representation.identity: bounded subsystem with one declared role
representation.energy: task throughput, service liveness, queue pressure
representation.flux: kernel events, service inputs, local emissions
representation.dependency: kernel, registry, other organs, external transports
representation.invariant: an organ does not redefine policy or source-of-truth hierarchy
representation.failure_mode: open membrane, transitional debt, hidden state spill

representation.identity: one process, one unit, one socket, or one short-lived runtime
representation.boundary: systemd unit, container, daemon, process group
representation.state: pid, unit status, local cache, readiness
representation.memory: local filesystem state, journal, ephemeral runtime memory
representation.observation: health probes, logs, metrics, socket reads
representation.invariant: a cell serves one immediate responsibility
representation.failure_mode: crash loop, stale config, unavailable port, supervisor drift

representation.state: arguments, config, env, parse tree, dispatch result
representation.energy: build time, runtime cost, control-flow depth
representation.memory: module constants, cache, source, generated output
representation.action: pure function, adapter call, command dispatch, wrapper run
representation.invariant: modules should not become hidden organs
representation.failure_mode: monolith, circular dependency, hardcoded path, mixed concern

representation.identity: machine, network link, power budget, thermal envelope
representation.boundary: host, VM, LXC, container, mesh membership
representation.energy: watts, heat, battery, bandwidth, attention, wall time
representation.flux: packets, interrupts, disk I/O, GPU load, human commands
representation.memory: hardware state, firmware state, persistent disks, external reality
representation.observation: provider evidence, Tailscale/Headscale reachability, kernel health
representation.action: boot, provision, route, isolate, deploy, shut down
representation.dependency: power, storage, routing, identity, provider truth
representation.failure_mode: partition, saturation, stale reservation, missing evidence

representation.identity: lower bound of the analogy, not a governable body
representation.observation: only the failure of the analogy can be observed here
representation.invariant: do not confuse physical limit with a source-of-truth layer
representation.failure_mode: category error, where analogy is mistaken for authority
